messages:
ana (PM): short thread  customer wants a clear SLA appendix for BYOK + audit exports. need concrete numbers and product mapping.

mike (Eng-Sec): reality check: KMS hot-failover ~5m typical, full export (50-200GB) under Dedicated ~20-45m depending on region and IO. manual escrow flows are hours and require ops approvals.

sasha (Legal): we should offer tiered service credits (not cash). sample tiers: minor (SLO miss <4h) = 0.5% MRR credit, major (>=4h) = 1% MRR, critical (>=24h) = 2% MRR. per-incident cap 10%, annual cap 50%. include exclusions for legal holds, customer key compromise, force majeure, third-party KMS outage.

devin (AE): customers often want <24h export windows; propose a purchasable "priority compliance lane" guaranteeing 24h exports and 15m automated KMS failover monitoring.

tina (CS): auditors ask for artifacts: export manifest (export_id, tenant, timestamp, object list, sha256, signed_by, operator_id), runbook to produce within 5 business days.

mike (Eng-Sec): product work map:
- KMS: automated failover tests + SLO dashboard + scheduled chaos runs
- Export: resumable streaming export + priority lane + size-based throttles
- Evidence: signed manifests, chain-of-custody entries, per-tenant retention toggles

opsbot: Deploy note: export-worker-v2 rollback safety verified 2025-11-03T08:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

sasha (Legal): I'll draft an SLA appendix template + credit table by Wednesday. include exec escalation path for bigger remedies.

ana (ana (PM)): action items:
1) eng: effort estimate for failover harness + dashboard (1-3w)
2) eng: prototype resumable export + priority lane (4-6w)
3) legal/product: finalize credit table and exclusions (this week)
4) cs: collect top customer contract asks (EOD)
5) security/ops: outline escrow ops, approvals, and cost delta.

mike (Eng-Sec): sample export manifest (example only):
```json
{
  "export_id": "exp_2487659999_001",
  "tenant": "example-corp",
  "created_at": "2025-11-03T07:58:00Z",
  "objects": ["s3://rwd-exports/example/part-0000.gz"],
  "sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...",
  "signed_by": "redwood-ops-21",
  "chain_of_custody": ["requested_by:client@example.com","approved_by:ops@redwood.com"]
}
```

ana (ana (PM)): thanks all  I'll attach this to the PRD and contract appendix. syncing Fri 9am to review Sasha's draft. :thumbsup:
